tx_pending_insufficient_gas.meaning: a transaction calling increaseLiquidityCurrentRange has insufficient gas and may not be mined immediately

late_execution_occurred.meaning: a pending increaseLiquidityCurrentRange transaction is executed at a later time after its intended deadline, at a disadvantage to the original submitter

assumptions: The deadline parameter is intended to bound the time window in which a pending increaseLiquidityCurrentRange transaction may be executed.
The original submitter is the party whose transaction is delayed and later executed.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a concrete deadline value or intended deadline bound, so the late-execution timing cannot be expressed as a numeric comparison.
Report does not specify the concrete disadvantage or amount lost to the original submitter, so the disadvantage is carried only as a qualitative Boolean.
Report does not state who submits the delayed transaction or whether the attacker is permissionless.

limitations: The deadline no-op root cause is not encoded as a precondition; it is the mechanism by which the temporal obligation fails.
Late execution is represented as a qualitative Boolean because no numeric deadline or expected-versus-actual values are supplied.
Only the malicious_late_execution impact is formalized in this plan.
